name: daily-space
description: Daily Space — quiet glass productivity for tasks, planning, calendar, mail digest, and teamwork.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap sync

scripts.cap:run:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run ios
